title: Staged production BuildingChunks update timing

machine.note: Node CPU-only wall-clock measurements; other host activity was not isolated. No browser/GPU timing or renderer frame pacing.

workload.inputQueue: All 850 buildingKit groups were generated and passed to BuildingChunks.set() before the first update().

interpretation: buildingKitGeneration is measured separately from sourceQueueIncludingOutlines; the latter includes group traversal and exact outline extraction performed synchronously by BuildingChunks.set().
chunkUpdateDrainWallTime and the perUpdate distribution measure only calls to staged BuildingChunks.update() after the full fixture has been queued. These do not include renderer-side GPU upload.

Per-update work is bounded by mesh/vertex preparation caps, merger vertex/index quotas and a contour-copy quota. A single authored mesh exceeding the preparation quota remains a synchronous transform/color clone and is reported above.
Per-update p95/max are samples from one complete fixture drain, not repeated independent runs or a frame-rate estimate. This audit does not measure memory or rendering quality.
